subject: Air freight quote to BKK
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to BKK (Bangkok, TH)? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28 at our site in 81617 (Munich South), Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the airport.

We are shipping spare parts for packaging machines: 8 pieces with a gross weight of 1708 kg and a total volume of 5.32 cbm.

Please send us your all-in price in EUR, including pickup, and let us know the earliest arrival you can offer at BKK.

Thank you.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
